principles: The shell never executes arbitrary commands or manifest-provided shell strings.
Intent actions are limited to a reviewed local allowlist and require explicit approval.
Unconfigured capabilities default to denied in the shell preference profile.
File inspection and hashing run locally; uploads are not performed by the shell.
A UI control is not evidence that a kernel, driver, updater, model or runtime is connected.

desktop.scope: browser shell, responsive layout, draggable windows, dock, seven original app panels and seven system tools

intent_ui.scope: offline allowlisted actions, preview and explicit confirmation

local_ai_and_npu.scope: no local model runtime, NPU enumeration or kernel scheduling

approval_zones.scope: Mora intent actions only; system-level approvals require native broker

immutable_updates.scope: shell settings snapshot only; no atomic OS image updater

app_sandboxing.scope: policy documented; browser prototype does not sandbox native processes

zero_trust_permissions.scope: deny-by-default shell preferences; no kernel enforcement

provenance.scope: local SHA-256; C2PA signature and manifest verification absent

adaptive_workspace.scope: Responsive browser layout, reduced-motion preference and one fixed DuckOS black/white/yellow palette; native display migration, XR and hardware adaptation remain absent.

multimodal_input.scope: keyboard, pointer and touch; no voice or spatial input service

material_interface.scope: Fixed DuckOS black/white/yellow palette, near-black radial workspace, white content, duck-yellow accent and restrained fold texture; no alternate palette modes.

compatibility.scope: Read-only PE32/PE32+ header, section and import-DLL inspection; isolated prefix scaffolding and CLI launch diagnostics; no native NT/Win32 process runtime, DirectX translation or Windows execution

declarative_configuration.scope: versioned local shell preferences; no full OS desired-state manager

accessibility.scope: reduced-motion controls and responsive layout; more contrast and assistive profiles remain

energy_awareness.scope: user-selectable shell preference only; no CPU/GPU power scheduler or VRR control

shared_design_system.scope: One fixed versioned DuckOS palette with semantic colors, geometry, spacing, typography and motion tokens; native adapters remain distinct and must preserve semantic roles and contrast.

installable_workspace.scope: web manifest and scoped offline cache; not an OS installer

gaming_performance.scope: Mora Boost links to OPlague's Windows workbench; no direct browser PCI, GPU, driver or power-plan access

desktop_optimizer.scope: native Python user-space utility for read-only desktop/process audit, reversible current-user startup management and confirmed move-to-Inbox; no native compositor, virtual desktop manager, kernel scheduler or machine-wide service control

language_profile.scope: Persistent ru-RU and Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) selection in Mora Control, with localized desktop metadata, app launcher labels, date/time and Red Sparrow; legacy application panels are not yet all translated.

red_sparrow_workspace.scope: Creative Wuxia production workspace inside Mora with Russian and Simplified Chinese content, local note editor and stage-safe visual design; not a native combat system or executable third-party extension.

local_first_documents.scope: IndexedDB-first bounded browser document store with a localStorage fallback for Red Sparrow notes; no CRDT replication, cross-device sync or native SQLite service is connected.
